reason: A native integration bundle that connects DeepSeek Harness to OpenClaw via ACP and routes configured messaging conversations, including WeChat through an external channel plugin.

summaries.zh: 通过官方 ACP 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体配置接入 OpenClaw，并把已配置消息渠道中的对话转发到 Harness。
summaries.en: Connects a DeepSeek Harness agent profile to OpenClaw through the official ACP transport and routes conversations from configured messaging channels to Harness.

capabilities: Exposes a DeepSeek Harness profile to OpenClaw through the Agent Client Protocol
Routes prompts and assistant responses between configured OpenClaw channels and DeepSeek Harness
Launches the configured Harness ACP process through OpenClaw ACPX
Supports messaging-channel integration such as WeChat through a separate OpenClaw channel plugin
